description: Single-VM scenario delivering the Mattermost docker-compose stack (postgres + mattermost + provisioner) on admin-mattermost-standalone (VMID 1182, IP 192.168.142.182, vmbr142) via the shared bundle bundles/admin/software.install.mattermost/, against the catalog element range42-catalog/03_container_layer/docker/admin/mattermost/. Mattermost is modeled as an admin-tier service gated by INSTALL_MATTERMOST (default YES - mattermost_lab is the Mattermost showcase scenario). Template VMID 9232 (template-vm-medium-02-8g-64g, 2cpu/8gb/64gb) is built by this scenario's 01_templates-bootstrap/ (idempotent : skipped if already present from another scenario such as blank_scenario_2_subnets, demo_lab, misp_lab, or nextcloud_lab).
